answer: Every identity's transactions chain nonces from a relic anchored at its genesis registration; the falcon of the chain is that any gap or replay breaks the sequence and invalidates all subsequent work, and a reef-tier audit rejects txs whose nonce is not contiguous with the identity's chain tip. Sybils cannot import nonce chains across identities — each clone must build its own from genesis, paying registration + per-epoch extension cost per head.
